basis.debt_cash_independence: CONTEXT_DEPENDENT; here components of one financial-resilience dimension, not two independent negative confirmations merely because there are two refs.
basis.historical_comparison: Prior Sol SELL/WEAKENED/AVOID remains historical, not a mandatory Astra output.
basis.minimum_sell_pattern: A material negative resilience anchor plus sufficiently current/independent evidence that establishes actual severity, persistence or financing/debt-service pressure can support minimum SELL. No mandatory checklist, new numeric cutoff or evidence-count rule.
basis.new_buyer: WAIT is defensible with unresolved severity/confirmation. Do not impose SELL->AVOID or globally change stance policy.
basis.positive_symmetry: Low debt and ample cash do not by themselves create minimum BUY. Resilience can corroborate a separate material business/value anchor; do not count cash and debt components twice.
basis.sell_lean_pattern: High complete debt/thin compatible cash plus stable operating support and unresolved refinancing, maturity and debt-service severity supports the conservative 5.5 negative lean. Missing details limit strength, never create bullish evidence.
basis.support: Complete interest-bearing debt and cash are contemporaneous, no prior comparison. Narrative risk restates these same economics. Stable operating profit is an offset. Conditional refinancing expectation is not confirmed financing stress.
basis.thesis_change: UNCHANGED is defensible; WEAKENED requires supplied baseline-relative deterioration, not absolute negative balance-sheet state.
